label: Diagram 43
caption: Diagram 43 Separation or shielding of liquefied petroleum gas tanks of up to 1.1 tonne capacity from buildings, boundaries and fixed sources of ignition
description: Diagram 43 is headed "Separation or shielding of liquefied petroleum gas tanks of up to 1.1 tonne capacity from buildings, boundaries and fixed sources of ignition" and shows four line drawings, labelled (a) to (d), together with a text box titled "Example". Part (a), "No fire wall", shows an oval "Tank" below a bar labelled "Building boundary or fixed source of ignition", with a double arrow between them marked "Table 11 Column (B)". Part (b), "Separate fire wall", adds a thin rectangle (the fire wall) between the bar and the tank, with a double arrow between the bar and the rectangle marked "Table 11 Column (C)" and the text "1-1.5m separation between tank and fire wall" pointing to the gap between the rectangle and the tank. Part (c), captioned "Boundary incorporating fire wall or Building incorporating fire wall (see also Diagram (d) below)", shows a tank below a bar labelled "Boundary or building incorporating fire wall", with a double arrow on the left marked "Table 11 Column (C)" and a double arrow on the right marked "Table 11 Column (B)". The "Example" box states that a 1.1 tonne tank could be located 3m from a boundary (Diagram (a)) or 2m from a boundary with an intervening fire wall, the fire wall standing between 1m and 1.5m from the tank and wide enough to ensure the shortest path from tank to boundary remains 3m (Diagram (b)). Part (d), "Fire wall is part of the building wall", is a perspective of a hipped-roof building with a horizontal "Up to 1.1 tonne" tank outside on the right; labels include "No part of structure to directly overhang the tank", "Should be 1m either side of pressure relief valve" with a dimension "1m-2m", a vertical dimension "9m or to eaves", "Imperable (without exception - see paragraph 1.10) and with 60 minutes fire resistance (insulation integrity and stability)", "Height to top of pressure relief valve", and references to Table 11 Column (C) and Table 11 Column (B) (See Diagram (c) above).
